tagline.en: Housing help for urban families earning up to ₹9 lakh
tagline.hi: ₹9 लाख तक आय वाले शहरी परिवारों को आवास सहायता
tagline.te: ₹9 లక్షల వరకు ఆదాయం ఉన్న పట్టణ కుటుంబాలకు గృహ సాయం

change_note.en: PMAY-U 2.0 launched; income ceiling now ₹9 lakh (MIG).
change_note.hi: PMAY-U 2.0 शुरू; आय सीमा अब ₹9 लाख (MIG)।
change_note.te: PMAY-U 2.0 ప్రారంభం; ఆదాయ పరిమితి ఇప్పుడు ₹9 లక్షలు (MIG).

source.quote: Families belonging to EWS/LIG/MIG category, living in urban areas, having no pucca house anywhere in the country, are eligible to purchase or construct a house under PMAY-U 2.0.
Families belonging to EWS/LIG/MIG category, living in urban areas, having no pucca house anywhere in the country, are eligible to purchase or construct a house under PMAY-U 2.0.

EWS households are defined as households with an annual income of up to ₹3 lakh. LIG is defined as households with an annual income from ₹3 lakh up to ₹6 lakh. MIG is defined as households with an annual income from ₹6 lakh up to ₹9 lakh.

summary.en: Up to ₹2,50,000 central assistance per house

source.quote: Central assistance of ₹2,50,000 per unit for Beneficiary Led Construction and Affordable Housing in Partnership

summary.en: Apply on the PMAY-U 2.0 portal or at your municipality office.
summary.hi: PMAY-U 2.0 पोर्टल या नगरपालिका कार्यालय में आवेदन करें।
summary.te: PMAY-U 2.0 పోర్టల్‌లో లేదా మీ మున్సిపల్ కార్యాలయంలో దరఖాస్తు చేయండి.

source.quote: Apply online on the PMAY-U 2.0 portal or at your Urban Local Body (municipality) office.
